paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.62% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+1.05%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-3.31%). Brent crude changed +6.06% to 106.27. Gold changed +1.15% to 4,188.5. Bitcoin changed +2.45% to 83,678.3203. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.217%, a relative move of -0.99%. Among the firms tracked, ConocoPhillips (+8.93%) and BP (+7.82%) moved the most.
